title: Prospect score
description: The `data` of GET /v2/drip-campaigns/:campaignId/prospects/score?email=<email>. Drives the score, ring and bars of the 'Lead strength' card in the prospect profile. What the prospect DID (replied, opened, clicked) is not part of this API: the portal reads it from its own tracking. The standard ResponseSuccessInterceptor wraps it as { success, statusCode, path, data, timestamp }.

email.description: The prospect's email, echoed back exactly as requested.

score.description: Total score. Must equal the sum of components[].points and be <= maxScore.

maxScore.description: Highest possible score (100 today). Must equal the sum of components[].maxPoints.

band.description: Bucket for the score. Suggested: strong >= 80, good >= 60, fair >= 40, else weak.

headline.description: Short line under the score, e.g. 'Strong — good fit, reachable now'. Must not claim a reply or an open: the portal shows those from its own tracking.

components.description: Score breakdown, in display order. Each one is drawn as a bar and as one segment of the score ring.

scoredAt.description: When this score was last computed (ISO 8601, UTC).
